players.nameZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多

bio.zh: 葡萄牙历史射手王，五夺金球奖，国家队绝对核心。
bio.en: Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for and captains the Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Portugal national team. Widely regarded as one of the greatest players in history and the greatest Portuguese player ever, he has won numerous individual accolades throughout his career, including five Ballon d'Or awards, a record three UEFA Men's Player of the Year Awards, and four European Golden Shoes. He was named the world's best player five times by FIFA.

bio.zh: 曼联队长，葡萄牙中场大脑，传射俱佳、跑动积极。
bio.en: Bruno Miguel Borges Fernandes is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United, which he captains, and the Portugal national team. He is widely regarded as one of the best attacking midfielders in the world.

bio.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼前锋，2022年世界杯顶替C罗首发戴帽成名。
bio.en: Gonçalo Matias Ramos is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club AC Milan and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 曼城进攻核心，技术细腻、跑动勤勉的葡萄牙中场。
bio.en: Bernardo Mota Veiga de Carvalho e Silva is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 天赋异禀的葡萄牙前锋，盘带出色，曾效力马竞。
bio.en: João Félix Sequeira is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 狼队门将，反应迅速，曾长期效力希腊奥林匹亚科斯。
bio.en: José Pedro Malheiro de Sá is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 葡萄牙多面手后卫，可踢中卫与边后卫，现效力西甲。
bio.en: Renato da Palma Veiga is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Villarreal and the Portugal national team. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a left-back or defensive midfielder.

bio.zh: 葡萄牙体育青训中卫，左脚出球型后卫，防守稳健。
bio.en: Gonçalo Bernardo Inácio is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼年轻中场，跑动积极、拼抢凶狠。
bio.en: João Pedro Gonçalves Neves is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team. Primarily a central midfielder, Neves is also able to play as a defensive midfielder and occasionally a right-back. He is regarded as one of the best young players in the world.

bio.zh: 葡萄牙边路攻击手，技术细腻，曾效力巴塞罗那。
bio.en: Francisco António Machado Mota de Castro Trincão is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 米兰边路爆点，速度快、盘带犀利，2022年意甲MVP。
bio.en: Rafael "Rafa" Alexandre da Conceição Leão is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Serie A club AC Milan and the Portugal national team. He is known for his dribbling and speed.

bio.zh: 切尔西边锋，突破能力强，曾效力狼队与拉齐奥。
bio.en: Pedro Lomba Neto is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Chelsea and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 葡萄牙边路快马，左右脚均衡，曾效力巴黎与瓦伦西亚。
bio.en: Gonçalo Manuel Ganchinho Guedes is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for La Liga club Real Sociedad and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 进攻型边后卫，传中与内切出色，曾效力曼城与拜仁。
bio.en: João Pedro Cavaco Cancelo is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a right-back or left-back for Saudi Pro League club Al Hilal and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 葡萄牙中场指挥官，长传调度精准，曾长期效力狼队。
葡萄牙体育门将，经验丰富，曾效力格拉纳达与贝蒂斯。
巴黎圣日耳曼中场，传球视野好，跑动覆盖能力强。
马略卡防守型中场/后卫，身体强壮，拦截能力突出。
巴黎圣日耳曼左边后卫，速度奇快，葡萄牙体育青训。
尤文图斯边锋，突破犀利，波尔图名帅之子。
bio.en: Francisco "Chico" Fernandes da Conceição is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Serie A club Juventus and the Portugal national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰年轻门将，反应敏捷，2023年加盟布莱顿后逐渐坐稳主力。

players.nameZh: 卢特沙雷尔·海特勒伊达

bio.zh: 费耶诺德青训出身的多面手后卫，可胜任右后卫与中后卫。
bio.en: Lutsharel Emiliano Geertruida is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for German Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Netherlands national team. Mainly a right-back, he can also play as a centre-back and defensive midfielder.

bio.zh: 经验丰富的中场铁闸，曾征战英超，现效力于亚特兰大。
bio.en: Marten Elco de Roon is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Atalanta and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰国家队队长，世界级中后卫，以领袖气质与制空能力著称。
bio.en: Virgil van Dijk is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for and captains both Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team. Widely regarded as one of the best defenders of his generation, and one of the greatest defenders in Premier League history, he is known for his strength, leadership, speed and aerial ability.

bio.zh: 左脚中后卫，出球稳健，曾在切尔西青训，后于伯恩茅斯成名。
bio.en: Nathan Benjamin Aké is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰新生代中卫，身体强壮，出自布雷达青训，后登陆英超。
bio.en: Jan Paul van Hecke is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 传奇前锋帕特里克·克鲁伊维特之子，司职边锋，速度快突破犀利。
bio.en: Justin Dean Kluivert is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰中场新星，身材高大技术细腻，2023年自拜仁转投利物浦。
bio.en: Ryan Jiro Gravenberch is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 高中锋，支点作用明显，曾租借效力曼联，经验丰富。
bio.en: Wout François Maria Weghorst is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Twente and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰锋线核心，脚法出众，曾效力曼联、里昂与巴萨等豪门。
bio.en: Memphis Depay, commonly known simply as Memphis, is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Corinthians in the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and the Netherlands national team. He is the all-time top scorer for the national team with 55 goals. In addition to his football career, Memphis is also a musician.

bio.zh: 埃因霍温青训出品的攻击手，2023年加盟利物浦后表现亮眼。
bio.en: Cody Mathès Gakpo is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left winger or centre forward for Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰后腰，跑动覆盖大，传球视野好，在费耶诺德崭露头角。
bio.en: Mats Henrik Berne Wieffer is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or defensive midfielder for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰年轻门将，出自阿尔克马尔青训，曾效力于NEC奈梅亨。
bio.en: Robin Gerardus Petrus Roefs is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Sunderland and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 技术型中场，跑动积极，2023年从阿尔克马尔加盟AC米兰后迅速成为主力。
速度极快的左脚中后卫，2023年从沃尔夫斯堡加盟热刺。
攻击型中场，后插上得分能力强，曾闯荡俄超与土超，现回归PSV。
bio.en: Guus Berend Til is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Eredivisie club PSV. Born in Zambia, he plays for the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰边锋，盘带突破犀利，曾在阿贾克斯青训，后于布鲁日成名。
bio.en: Noa Noëll Lang is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left winger or left midfielder for Süper Lig club Galatasaray, on loan from Serie A club Napoli, and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 速度快、射术好的边锋，出自阿森纳青训，后于多特蒙德打出高光。
bio.en: Donyell Malen is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger or striker for Serie A club Roma and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 阿贾克斯青训出品的力量型中锋，冲击力强，曾在莱比锡短暂效力。
bio.en: Brian Ebenezer Adjei Brobbey is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Sunderland and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 全能中场，远射与头球俱佳，2024年从亚特兰大加盟尤文图斯。
bio.en: Teun Koopmeiners is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Juventus and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰中场大脑，控球摆脱能力顶级，2019年从阿贾克斯加盟巴萨。
bio.en: Frenkie de Jong is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 体能充沛的右翼卫，冲击力极强，2021年从埃因霍温加盟国际米兰。
bio.en: Denzel Justus Morris Dumfries is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 德国出生的荷兰门将，脚下技术出色，曾长期效力于弗赖堡。
bio.en: Mark Maria Hubertus Flekken is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 荷兰边锋，突破速度快，出自费耶诺德青训，在利兹联打出名堂。
bio.en: Crysencio Jilbert Sylverio Cirro Summerville is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship football club West Ham United and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 阿贾克斯青训培养的左脚多面手，可胜任中卫与左后卫，潜力出众。
bio.en: Jorrel Evan Hato is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the Netherlands national team.

bio.zh: 尤里安·廷贝尔的双胞胎兄弟，中场球员，2024年从费耶诺德加盟马赛。
bio.en: Quinten Ryan Crispito Timber is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Ligue 1 club Marseille and the Netherlands national team. He is the twin brother of Arsenal defender Jurriën Timber, and they have an elder brother, Dylan, who is also a professional footballer.
